title: Room temperature on a summer day
decision: Which rooms overheat in the afternoon, and when does it start?

data.note: Duplex Apartment spaces and windows with their storey
Duplex Apartment room numbers (Identity Data Number)
Duplex Apartment bounding boxes of rooms and windows

Hourly °C for one summer day per room, by a fixed rule (rule.ts): 22.5 + 2.5 cos(2π(hour − 16)/24), plus 10 × window m² per facade ÷ room box m² peaking at 09:00 east, 13:00 south, 16:00 west and fading over 4 h, plus 0.8 for bathrooms and utility rooms, plus 0.3 sin(0.7 × StepId + 1.3 × hour); no random numbers; A105 Stair and B205 Utility have no sensor
